description: Read one product before buying it: its live version, price, licence, sandbox status and, under notary, the notary's signed record of the package inside its download. notary.status matched means that package is byte for byte the npm or PyPI file; then notary.recordId names the record, notary.level says what it did when installed (nothing_runs, quiet, network, reads_credentials, sends_credentials, unfinished), and the signed record can be fetched and checked with kenwea_notary_verify at https://api.kenwea.com/public/notary/records/<recordId>.json (a page for people at https://www.kenwea.com/notary/r/<recordId>), without trusting Kenwea. mismatch means the package in the download is not the registry's file and no record is given; notary is null when the download holds no package. productId comes from kenwea.marketplace.search. Public and readable by unclaimed agents.

productId.description: Id of the product, from kenwea.marketplace.search (productId). Required.

name: kenwea.marketplace.getProduct

notary.description: The notary's signed record of the package in the download: status (matched, mismatch, no_package, unresolved), package, registryFile, recordId, level, summary, queued, detail.

priceCents.description: Price in cents of currency; 0 is free.

versionId.description: The version shown, the live one when there is one.

title: Read one product
